notes.sowing: Sow {cm:1.3} deep from 5 weeks before your last frost, {cm:2.5} apart so no thinning is needed. Sow a short row every 10 days for a steady supply, and pause in summer heat.
notes.care: Keep the soil evenly moist: dry or uneven watering gives woody, split or very hot roots. Warm weather makes radishes bolt instead of forming roots, so sow fall batches once it cools.
notes.harvest: Pull 3 to 5 weeks after sowing, when roots are about {cm:2.5} across. Left too long, they turn pithy and hot.
